description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the named subarea. GPS points locate weather stations used and maintained by Pierce County Surface Water Management. Field definitions cover station identity, installation/removal dates, status and available weather-sensor types. These source-defined assets, service areas or operating constraints provide inputs for network flow studies. This is a station-location and instrumentation inventory. No weather observations were retrieved or inferred from the sensor fields. Access is through the public county catalogue and ArcGIS REST layer metadata, with GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile export descriptors advertised by the provider. No feature records or files were downloaded. Licence terms are referred to a county PDF that was not opened; charges are not stated. The additional county GIS metadata HTML route failed during TLS negotiation. A limitation is that field definitions do not establish attribute completeness, present serviceability or observation dates. A regular update frequency is not stated. No exact related active resource was established for this group.
